links.outcome: Proportion of ambient AI draft notes edited by clinicians before signing
links.effect: 84.4% of 23,760 notes were edited before sign-off, so about 15.6% were signed unedited; edit rates varied by note section, specialty and individual clinician.
links.quote: Across 23,760 notes that included one or more ambient AI sections, 84.4% were edited by clinicians before signing off.

unlisted_practices: Analyzing clinician edit patterns (Myers diff) of ambient AI drafts by note section, specialty and clinician
Linguistic and readability comparison of AI drafts versus clinician-finalized notes

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating real-world deployment data from ambient AI clinical documentation tools, specifically measuring the extent and nature of clinician editing/review (a human-in-the-loop deployment safeguard) before finalizing notes.

primary.practice: clinician review and editing of AI-generated notes
